Text.Page:
[EN] Not far from here is another scout, {@LinkCreature:203#1010#Rasima}. She's as tough as they come, but she's all alone.

She'd never ask for help, she's all into having altitude, but she'll take it if it's offered. And bring her something to drink!
[ES] No muy lejos de aquí hay otra exploradora, {@LinkCreature:203#1010#Rasima}. Es más dura que ninguna, pero está completamente sola.

Nunca pediría ayuda, le encanta estar en las alturas, pero la aceptará si se la ofrecen. ¡Y llévale algo de beber!

[EN] Yes, I'm all alone—now. My partner, Keleth, and I were discovered while scouting around. We fought hard, but he bought my escape with his life.

I honor his sacrifice but need a favor. Bring back his {@LinkCreature:203#1029#ring} that I might return them to his home and thank his family.
[ES] Sí, estoy completamente sola... ahora. Mi compañero Keleth y yo fuimos descubiertos mientras explorábamos. Luchamos duro, pero él compró mi huida con su vida.

Honro su sacrificio, pero necesito un favor. Trae de vuelta su {@LinkCreature:203#1029#ring} para poder devolvérselo a su hogar y agradecer a su familia.

[EN] (The corpse was clearly savaged in battle. Nothing stands out except a simple copper ring.)
[ES] (El cadáver estaba claramente destrozado en la batalla. Nada destaca excepto un simple anillo de cobre.)

[EN] I remember this ring. Keleth was very proud of such a humble band.

This is perfect. Such a token will mean much to his loved ones. Thank you for this. May the Shieldmaiden protect you in all your battles!
[ES] Recuerdo este anillo. Keleth estaba muy orgulloso de una banda tan humilde.

Esto es perfecto. Una muestra así significará mucho para sus seres queridos. Gracias por esto. ¡Que la Shieldmaiden te proteja en todas tus batallas!
